searchUrls.title: Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Fallback public SS.com apartment sale searches. When the Sheets bridge is available, active Search_URLs rows are used instead.

minProfit.title: Minimum profit (€)
minProfit.description: Minimum expected profit used by the later deal-analysis stage.

maxListingsPerRun.title: Maximum candidates
maxListingsPerRun.description: FULL_SCAN accepts up to 1000 candidates. INCREMENTAL is always capped at 100 new or changed listings while still checking page 1 of every active URL.

scrapeDetails.title: Scrape detail pages
scrapeDetails.description: Visit public listing detail pages for descriptions, images and optional metadata.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Process and emit results without updating persistent seen-history records.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: INCREMENTAL uses at most four simultaneous HTTP requests. FULL_SCAN remains capped at five.

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: INCREMENTAL is capped at 0.2 seconds; retries still use Crawlee backoff. FULL_SCAN uses this configured delay.

runMode.title: Run mode
runMode.description: FULL_SCAN evaluates every current listing without deleting history. INCREMENTAL evaluates only new or materially changed listings.

sendSummaryHeartbeat.title: Send Telegram run summary
sendSummaryHeartbeat.description: Deprecated compatibility option. A concise Telegram summary is now sent after every non-dry run.

diagnosticForceNewListings.title: Diagnostic forced listings
diagnosticForceNewListings.description: Testing only: re-evaluate up to 20 unchanged listings without clearing or damaging persistent history.
